title: FTEQTV
wikitext:
'''FTEQTV''' is a streaming proxy. It is designed to sit somewhere between a compatible server, and any standard [[:Category:Clients|client]]. It was written from scratch by [[Spike]].

It was the first widely used and tested [[QuakeTV]], it's development started in September [[2005]]. Later [[EZTV]] derived from this project.
